## What Are Game Pillars? / 什么是游戏支柱？

Pillars are the 3-5 non-negotiable principles that define this game's identity.
支柱是定义这个游戏身份的3-5个不可协商的原则。
Every design, art, audio, narrative, and technical decision must serve at least
每个设计、艺术、音频、叙事和技术决策必须服务至少
one pillar. If a feature doesn't serve a pillar, it doesn't belong in the game.
一个支柱。如果一个功能不服务支柱，它就不属于这个游戏。

**Why pillars matter / 为什么支柱重要**: In a typical development cycle, the team makes thousands
在典型的开发周期中，团队做出数千个
of small creative decisions. Pillars ensure all those decisions push in the same
direction, creating a coherent player experience rather than a collection of
disconnected features.
小型创意决策。支柱确保所有这些决策都朝同一方向推进，创造连贯的玩家体验，而不是一堆脱节的功能。

### What Makes a Good Pillar / 什么构成好的支柱

A good pillar is:
好的支柱是：
- **Falsifiable / 可证伪的**: "Fun gameplay" is not a pillar. "Combat rewards patience over
  "有趣的游戏玩法"不是支柱。"战斗奖励耐心而非
  aggression" is — it makes a testable claim about design choices.
  侵略"是 — 它对设计选择做出了可测试的声明。
- **Constraining / 约束性的**: If a pillar never forces you to say no to something, it's
  如果支柱从不强迫你对某事说不，它
  too vague. Good pillars eliminate options.
  就太模糊了。好的支柱消除选项。
- **Cross-departmental / 跨部门的**: A pillar that only constrains game design but says
  只约束游戏设计但对艺术、音频或叙事
  nothing about art, audio, or narrative is incomplete. Real pillars shape
  一无所说的支柱是不完整的。真正的支柱塑造
  every discipline.
  每个学科。
- **Memorable / 易记的**: The team should be able to recite the pillars from memory.
  团队应该能够凭记忆背诵支柱。
  If they can't, the pillars are too numerous or too complex.
  如果不能，支柱就太多或太复杂。

### Real AAA Examples / 真实的AAA示例

These studios publicly shared their game pillars, showing how concrete and
这些工作室公开分享了他们的游戏支柱，展示了有效的支柱可以多么具体和
specific effective pillars can be:
具体：

| Game / 游戏 | Pillars / 支柱 | Why They Work / 为什么有效 |
| ---- | ---- | ---- |
| **God of War (2018) / 战神（2018）** | Visceral combat; Father-son emotional journey; Continuous camera (no cuts); Norse mythology reimagined / 内脏战斗；父子情感旅程；连续镜头（无剪切）；重新想象的北欧神话 | "Continuous camera" is radical — it cut a standard cinematic tool. "Father-son journey" constrains narrative, level design, AND combat (Atreus as companion). / "连续镜头"是激进的 — 它切断了标准电影工具。"父子旅程"约束了叙事、关卡设计和战斗（Atreus作为同伴）。 |
| **Hades / 哈迪斯** | Fast fluid combat; Story depth through repetition; Every run teaches something new / 快速流畅战斗；通过重复的故事深度；每次运行都教新东西 | "Story through repetition" justified the roguelike structure narratively — death IS the story. "Every run teaches" constrains level and encounter design. / "通过重复的故事"在叙事上证明了roguelike结构 — 死亡就是故事。"每次运行都教"约束了关卡和遭遇设计。 |
| **The Last of Us / 最后生还者** | Story is essential, not optional; AI partners build relationships; Stealth is always an option / 故事是必不可少的，不是可选的；AI伙伴建立关系；潜行始终是一个选择 | "AI partners build relationships" drove massive investment in companion AI — not just pathfinding, but emotional presence. / "AI伙伴建立关系"推动了对同伴AI的大量投资 — 不仅仅是寻路，还有情感存在。 |
| **Celeste / 蔚蓝** | Tough but fair; Accessibility without compromise; Story and mechanics are the same thing / 艰难但公平；不妥协的无障碍性；故事和机制是同一回事 | "Story and mechanics are the same thing" — climbing IS the struggle, the dash IS the anxiety. Pillar prevented mechanics from being "just gameplay." / "故事和机制是同一回事" — 攀爬就是挣扎，冲刺就是焦虑。支柱阻止了机制成为"只是游戏玩法"。 |
| **Hollow Knight / 空洞骑士** | Atmosphere over explanation; Earned mastery; World tells its own story / 氛围胜过解释；赢得的精通；世界讲述自己的故事 | "Atmosphere over explanation" — no tutorials, no hand-holding, the world teaches through environmental design. / "氛围胜过解释" — 没有教程，没有手把手，世界通过环境设计教授。 |
| **Dead Cells / 死亡细胞** | Every weapon is viable; Combat is a dance; Permanent death creates meaning / 每种武器都可行；战斗是舞蹈；永久死亡创造意义 | "Every weapon is viable" is extremely constraining — it demands constant balance work across hundreds of items. / "每种武器都可行"非常约束 — 它要求在数百个物品中进行持续的平衡工作。 |

## Core Fantasy / 核心幻想

> [What power, experience, or feeling does the player get from this game? What
> [玩家从这款游戏中获得什么力量、体验或感觉？
> can they do here that they can't do anywhere else? The core fantasy is the
> emotional promise — the answer to "why would someone choose THIS game?"
> 他们在这里能做什么在其他地方做不到的事情？核心幻想是
> Strong core fantasies are visceral and immediate:
> 情感承诺 — "为什么有人会选择这个游戏？"的答案
> - "You are a lone survivor building a new life in a hostile wilderness"
> - "你是敌对荒野中建立新生活的孤独幸存者"
> - "You command a civilization across millennia"
> - "你指挥跨越千年的文明"
> - "You explore a vast, beautiful world at your own pace"
> - "你按照自己的节奏探索广阔美丽的世界"
> - "You master intricate combat and overcome impossible odds"]
> - "你掌握复杂的战斗并克服不可能的几率"]

**Aesthetics reference / 美学参考** (Hunicke, LeBlanc, Zubek):
- **Sensation / 感觉**: Sensory pleasure (visual beauty, satisfying audio, haptic feedback / 感官愉悦（视觉美、令人满意的音频、触觉反馈）
- **Fantasy / 幻想**: Make-believe, inhabiting a role or world / 假装，扮演角色或世界
- **Narrative / 叙事**: Drama, story arcs, emotional plot progression / 戏剧、故事弧、情感情节进展
- **Challenge / 挑战**: Obstacle course, skill mastery, overcoming difficulty / 障碍课程、技能精通、克服困难
- **Fellowship / 友谊**: Social connection, cooperation, shared experience / 社交连接、合作、共享体验
- **Discovery / 发现**: Exploration, uncovering secrets, understanding hidden systems / 探索、揭开秘密、理解隐藏系统
- **Expression / 表达**: Self-expression, creativity, personal identity / 自我表达、创造力、个人身份
- **Submission / 沉浸**: Relaxation, comfort, meditative play / 放松、舒适、冥想游戏
